title: Assessing the Clinical Relevance ofRING Domain Variants of Uncertain Significance.
snippet: The BRCA1 protein serves an essential function in maintaining genomic integrity, to the extent that up to 80% of women carrying a pathogenicvariant develop breast cancer (BC).
